// ===== DISPLAY OBJECT =====
Adafruit_ILI9341 tft = Adafruit_ILI9341(TFT_CS, TFT_DC, TFT_RST);

void setup() {

  Serial.begin(115200);
  delay(1000);

  // Start SPI manually for ESP32-S3
  SPI.begin(TFT_CLK, TFT_MISO, TFT_MOSI, TFT_CS);

  tft.begin();
  tft.setRotation(1);     // Landscape (320x240)
  tft.fillScreen(ILI9341_BLACK);

  Serial.println("Drawing image...");

  tft.drawRGBBitmap(
    0,
    0,
    epd_bitmap_ecb92d18c7855c986a5571c1b6f7cad2,
    IMG_WIDTH,
    IMG_HEIGHT
  );

  Serial.println("Done!");
}

void loop() {
}
